scope: Same four selected samples per window; only the phase schedule changes. Fresh seeds and tones validate the EXP-049 bottleneck.
schedule_contract: fixed phase 0; rotate phase 0 then +1 mod 30 per complete window; pseudorandom phase state mod 30, state updated with masked unsigned xorshift(13,17,5) once after each complete window; no reset at sine transition
pseudorandom_seed_contract: trial phase_seed shared across paired curves, inputs and histories; independent of input/dither seed variables, deterministic after declaration
evaluation: primary continued-online sine SNDR and final integer-code MSE; secondary frozen training endpoint, SFDR, per-window target/error attribution and phase coverage; all_reference uses 120 products and is diagnostic only
candidate_support_criterion: each candidate evaluated separately: mean paired online SNDR gain over fixed > 0 dB, positive in at least 18 of 24 cells, and no paired loss exceeding 3 dB; this is a finite screening criterion, not a population confidence claim
resource_contract: same 4 selected samples, 8 gate-product sums, 2 banks and 160 commits; rotate adds 5 state bits; xorshift adds 32 state bits plus XOR/shift and constant remainder logic; shared within-window phase counter, enables and broadcast remain unverified chip assumptions
failure_policy: retain every cell, clipping and overload; no seed, frequency, step-size or curve replacement
limits: three seed groups, two previously inspected cubic curves and new sine tones; no chip, convergence, global optimality or hardware-cost victory claim
